record_audits.database_measure_value: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (30.85%) to Fc-SWD C: 14%, P: 13%. GRAVY: 0.0588, mol wt: 9326.989; mol formula: C410H637N107O115S12; mol ex coeff: 13340. Chemical modification: predicted six S-S bonds: C3–C28, C10–C42, C24–C41, C30–C50, C54–C64, and C28–C77. Activity: recombinant peptide (rPpRcys1) is active against Gram+ S. aureus ATCC 6538 (MIC 8 uM), Bacillus sp. T2 (MIC 8 uM), S. agalactiae ATCC 51487 (MIC 16 uM), Gram- A. hydrophila ATCC 35654 (MIC 32 uM), Acinetobacter sp. L32 (MIC 32 uM), E. coli ATCC 8739(MIC 16 uM), V. alginolyticus ATCC 17749 (MIC 16 uM), V. harveyi ATCC 43516 (MIC 32 uM), and V. anguillarum ATCC 14181 (MIC 32 uM). MBC was slightly higher than MIC. MOA:bacteria:S. aureus: MOA:bacteria:V. alginolyticus: permeated bacterial membranes. Recombinant production:bacteria:Escherichia coli: codon optimized, cloned into pSmartI vecto, IPTG-induced, and expressed in E. coli BL21(DE3) with the His-SUMO tag, yield: 100 mg/L. in vitro toxicity: fish RBC: 18.36% hemolysis at 32 uM.
